name: Documents (SOP)
description: Agent-facing SOP retrieval: semantic search, fetch whole sections, list a document's sections, and trigger re-ingestion. Id-only access; reads the ingested SOP corpus.

tools.name: search_sop
tools.documentation: Search SOPs for sections matching an error/trigger pattern; returns candidate section ids + metadata (no raw text).

tools.name: get_sop_section
tools.documentation: Fetch one SOP section in full (rendered markdown + ordered elements) by id.

tools.name: list_sop_sections
tools.documentation: List a document's sections by id (titles + element refs, no text).

tools.name: ingest_sop
tools.documentation: Trigger a background SOP re-ingestion when the agent detects content drift.
